Subject: Acceleron Health — closed / handing to CS (SOW + PO attached)

Team —

Great news: Acceleron Health signed the PO this morning (attached). High-level context so CS can pick up the implementation:

- Customer: Acceleron Health — mid-market digital care provider focusing on remote patient monitoring.
- Primary use case: embed Redwood inference into their triage workflow for automated note summarization + clinical QA.
- Commercials: $120k ARR first year; committed Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) + enterprise SSO; PO attached.
- Compliance: Customer requires SOC 2 + HIPAA BAA (signed copy attached).
- Go-live target: pilot readiness by 2026-09-20, production by 2026-11-01.
- Expected baseline throughput: 10 rps; peak bursts up to ~100 rps during office hours.
- Model: want to use our curated LLM variant (gpt-open-med-v1) with prefix caching and KV persistence.
- Network: customer prefers VPC peering to their AWS account (acct id: 999-111-222). They also requested KMS BYOK for keys.

Attached to this thread: Acceleron_SOW_v1.2.pdf, Acceleron_PO_20260810.pdf, BAA_Acceleron_signed.pdf

Action items for CS / Implementation:
1) Confirm CS owner and schedule a 60-min implementation kickoff with customer (include technical stakeholders).
2) Validate network/VPC peering requirements and whether they want Redwood Private or Dedicated with VPC peering.
3) Confirm data retention and audit-log SLOs (they flagged quarterly audit access).
4) Coordinate with Product on KV persistence behavior for long-term summaries.

Customer contacts:
- Jamie Cole (Technical Lead) — jamie.cole@acceleronhealth.com / +1 415-555-0142
- Procurement — procurement@acceleronhealth.com
- IT Ops — itops@acceleronhealth.com

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4437 (deal RWI-2026-4437)

Notes: Karthik ran the final demo yesterday and will stay on the first week of implementation for technical handoff.

Thanks — and sorry for the late hour. Please confirm who will own and I'll loop in customer for kickoff scheduling.

— Marissa

Thanks Marissa — congrats on the close. I will take overall ownership of the engagement and assign a primary CS manager. Initial questions before we set the kickoff:

1) Do they require Redwood Private (VPC + private control plane) or will Dedicated with peering suffice? Marissa, you mentioned "Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs)" in the email but their security lead referenced VPC peering + BYOK. Need clarity.
2) Confirm who at Acceleron will be the technical point-of-contact for networking (name + email).
3) Do they have an existing workspace or SSO provider we should prep for (Okta/Azure AD)?
4) Any special compliance reports needed beyond SOC2/BAA for the pilot?

I'll assign Rohan as the primary CS owner for day-to-day coordination. Rohan — if you can confirm availability for a kickoff the week of Aug 17 (preferably Aug 18 or 19) and take point on the VPC peering design, that would be great. Karthik: please plan to support the first two technical sessions (networking + model tuning).

Monica Patel
